title: Data and Training
introduction: Machine-learning systems build models by finding useful patterns in training data.
learningOutcomes: Explain the roles of training data and a model.

activities.question: Put the stages of a simple supervised-learning workflow in order.

items.text: Use the model to predict a label for a new example
Train a model to connect features with labels
Evaluate the model on separate examples

activities.explanation: Examples are prepared before training, evaluation checks unseen examples, and inference applies the resulting model.

activities.question: Using a trained model to make a prediction is called ___.
activities.explanation: Inference is the stage in which a trained model processes new input to produce an output.
